description: Explicit GGUF inference adapter for Khanary/llama-compatible servers and the WebGL2/ggml-XCFE proof path.

engine.safe_tensors_boundary: Convert/export explicitly to GGUF or use the native SafeTensors coder/trainer path.

webgl2_proof.fallback_policy: Use CPU or llama-server when the XCFE/WebGL2 provider reports device or architecture incompatibility.

model_selection.chat: GGUF with the model's declared chat template
model_selection.coder: GGUF exported from coder_ast_json_fp16.safetensors only after validation
model_selection.template_rule: Use tokenizer metadata/chat_template; do not force ChatML onto non-ChatML GPT-2 or coder exports.

continuation.protocol: repeat the message history, append the assistant segment, then request continuation
